cohort: This study included 79 adult morbidly obese premenopausal women with infertility or planning pregnancy who underwent either LSG (n=38) or LRYGB (n=41).
finding: Both LSG and LRYGB are effective and safe in improving fertility, achieving significant weight loss, and supporting favorable pregnancy outcomes in morbidly obese women, with LRYGB showing superior remission for type 2 diabetes and GERD.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were high in both surgical groups (63.1%-65.8%), which was attributed to cultural or provider preferences rather than surgical indication.
